requirements.quote: Manufacture complete as specified or required for operation and continuous service at the location indicated in the Contract Documents.
requirements.text: Manufacture equipment as specified for operation at the indicated location.

requirements.quote: Provide all openings in floors, walls, and other structures necessary for complete equipment installation, unless such openings are specifically indicated as being provided by others.
requirements.text: Provide necessary structural openings for equipment installation unless specified otherwise.

requirements.quote: Make all internal connections as required.
requirements.text: Perform all required internal connections.

requirements.quote: Check all internal connections, especially current transformer secondary short circuiting jumpers, and torque to MANUFACTURERs recommendation.
requirements.text: Verify and torque all internal connections per manufacturer's recommendations.

requirements.quote: Erect equipment enclosure and all components plumb, true, and conforming to MANUFACTURER’s printed instructions.
requirements.text: Install equipment enclosure per manufacturer's instructions.

requirements.quote: Provide all openings in floors, walls, and other structures necessary for complete equipment installation, unless such openings are specifically indicated as being provided by others.
requirements.text: Provide necessary structural openings for equipment installation unless specified otherwise.

requirements.quote: Roof penetrations shall not be permitted.
requirements.text: Do not allow roof penetrations.

requirements.quote: Level, shim, and anchor the prefabricated equipment enclosure to the foundation in accordance with the MANUFACTURERS instructions.
requirements.text: Level, shim, and anchor the enclosure per manufacturer's instructions.

requirements.quote: Replace any panels or components bent or otherwise damaged as result of PURCHASERS operations, or repair if damage is minor.
requirements.text: Replace or repair damaged panels or components caused by purchaser's operations.

requirements.quote: Megger each pole of breaker for freedom from grounds.
requirements.text: Test each breaker pole for grounding issues.

requirements.quote: Operate the breaker manually and visually inspect the breaker.
requirements.text: Manually operate and inspect the breaker.

requirements.quote: Adjust the gap of the primary contacts as per MANUFACTURER's instructions.
requirements.text: Adjust primary contact gap per manufacturer's instructions.

requirements.quote: Check for proper clearances of all items.
requirements.text: Verify proper clearances of all items.

requirements.quote: Check for proper lubrication.
requirements.text: Ensure proper lubrication.

requirements.quote: Inspect all bushings.
requirements.text: Inspect all bushings.

requirements.quote: Check all secondary contacts for proper operation.
requirements.text: Verify proper operation of all secondary contacts.

requirements.quote: With breaker in switchgear, operate the breaker electrically and check for proper operation.
requirements.text: Electrically operate the breaker in switchgear and verify operation.

requirements.quote: Check continuity of breaker frame ground.
requirements.text: Verify continuity of breaker frame ground.

requirements.quote: Check all safety interlock mechanisms for proper lubrication, adjustment and operation.
requirements.text: Inspect and adjust safety interlock mechanisms for proper operation.

requirements.quote: Megger all power buses with a 1,000-volt megger. Grounded AC circuits, instruments and fuses should not be meggered.
requirements.text: Test power buses with a 1,000-volt megger, excluding grounded AC circuits.

requirements.quote: Inspect all buses and insulators.
requirements.text: Inspect all buses and insulators.

requirements.quote: Inspect control and instrument switches and adjust contacts if required.
requirements.text: Inspect and adjust control and instrument switches.

requirements.quote: Check all fuses.
requirements.text: Verify all fuses.

requirements.quote: Check connections to instruments and adjust instrument indicating pointers.
requirements.text: Verify instrument connections and adjust pointers.
